name: wire-uper-01-every-construct-loads
models:
module core
version 0.1.0
distribution public
source "probe"
key uid string -
key lat float deg
key lon float deg
key callsign string -
key time_ms int ms
module probe
version 0.1.0
distribution public
source "probe"
key n int -
key x int -
key y int -
key z int -
key w int -
key qty int -
key c1 int -
key c2 int -
key val int -
key a float -
key ratio float -
key label string -
key tag string -
key s1 string -
key s2 string -
list items "a list"
list names "a list"
pack:
format probe
version 0.19.0
distribution public
source "probe"
uses probe
wire bits
layout sequential
bit_order msb
encoding uper
field probe.n int:0:255 uint
also probe.qty
field probe.x int:-5:5:ext twos
field probe.y int:-5: twos
field probe.z int:: twos
field probe.a int:-9223372036854775808:9223372036854775807 sscale:1/4
field probe.w enum:65536:ext uint
field probe.c1 1 uint
field probe.label chars:8:8 ascii
field probe.tag chars: ascii
field probe.s1 octets:0:65535 hex
field probe.s2 octets: utf8
pad 3
ext
  presence p 2
  if p.1
    field probe.c2 int:0:15 uint
  end
  if p.2
    field probe.val int:0:1000 uint
  end
end
choice 65536 ext
  alt 0
    field probe.ratio int:0:3 uscale:1
  alt 65535
end
group probe.items size 0 65535
  field probe.ratio int:0:1023 uscale:1
end
group probe.names size
  field probe.label chars: ascii
end
